data.narrative:
Loyal is a Series C biotech & health company founded by Celine Halioua that has raised $250M+. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public-market biotech firms (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit at the same stage.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression uses total capital raised ($250M) as a proxy base and applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, implying a $425M valuation. The peer-median method anchors to three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Colossal Biosciences at $10.3B, Chai Discovery at $3.8B, and New Limit at $3.1B. The median of this peer set is $3.8B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples (6.6x median across the three public tickers) is not applicable owing to absence of disclosed revenue for the target.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $361M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.1B across the two applicable methods. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Loyal tracks toward the lower end anchored by capital-raised progression or the upper quartile populated by well-capitalized peers like Colossal. Revenue visibility and clinical/commercial progress relative to the peer cohort remain critical valuation drivers.
